showroom.name: braboj.me
showroom.description: This site — a minimal portfolio built with Astro, showcasing experience, skills, and projects. Open source and deployed via GitHub Pages.

showroom.name: imbra.io
showroom.tagline: Home of industrial software for the OT/IT boundary
showroom.description: The company site for Imbra — home of Imbra Connect, a suite of industrial protocol SDKs covering DeviceNet, Modbus, OPC-UA, and MQTT.

showroom.name: wuseria.com
showroom.tagline: Pick the right Fujifilm lens with lab data, not marketing
showroom.description: A lightweight, offline-friendly web tool that ranks 243 Fujifilm lenses by optical quality across nine photography genres — landscape, portrait, wildlife, and more. Also covers camera comparisons, accessories, and a wiki.

showroom.name: braboj.me/tutorial-git
showroom.tagline: Concepts before commands — Git for engineers
showroom.description: A structured Git tutorial in nine chapters that teaches the model before the muscle memory. Includes a 17-recipe playbook and a glossary for fast lookup.

showroom.name: braboj.me/tutorial-python
showroom.tagline: Learn Python by Example — 200+ runnable examples
showroom.description: A practical Python reference for junior, intermediate, and senior developers — over 200 examples covering syntax, idioms, and design patterns. Built to be read by running it.

demos.name: demo-randomgen
demos.tagline: Random number generator REST API with Flask
demos.description: A minimal REST API demo built with Flask — clean starting point for API design patterns.

demos.name: demo-sensor-app
demos.tagline: Simulated sensor data sampling with REST and Angular
demos.description: A full-stack demo app simulating industrial sensor data — REST API built with Flask, visualised with Angular.

demos.name: demo-the-great-wall
demos.tagline: REST API with multiprocessing and Django
demos.description: A REST API demo using Django and multiprocessing — built to demonstrate parallel workload handling patterns.

demos.name: demo-hvlp
demos.tagline: Simplified MQTT protocol demo for training
demos.description: A simplified MQTT protocol implementation used for training engineers on industrial messaging patterns.

demos.name: demo-state-machines
demos.description: A sample implementation of state machines in C — a fundamental pattern in embedded and industrial control systems.
